highlights: 修复 Still sending / Delivery not confirmed 触发自动切号重试，避免单个任务被放大到约 100 秒。
页面状态判断限制在当前聊天区域，避免侧栏历史状态误判新任务。
修复发送按钮误匹配侧栏历史、Send feedback 或 Resend 的问题，避免参考图和长提示词留在输入框未提交。
首次发送、重试和发送状态检查统一定位当前输入区域，识别中英文标签、disabled、aria-disabled 和 inert 状态。
继续校验实际发送及媒体成品；点击发送不等于任务完成，不把上传的参考素材当生成结果。
核验仓库、管理面板及中英文界面的社区推广内容清理状态；感谢 @WXJJ0520 的 PR #48。
更新服务后请强制刷新管理页。插件仍为 1.0.2、油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2；当前版本无需重装，旧扩展仍需在各浏览器个人资料中手动升级。
highlights_en: Stop Still sending / Delivery not confirmed from rotating accounts and multiplying one task into roughly 100 seconds.
Scope page-state checks to the active conversation so sidebar history cannot fail a new task.
Fix send-button matching against sidebar history, Send feedback and Resend, which could leave prompts and reference attachments unsubmitted.
Initial sends, retries and readiness checks share one composer-scoped locator with localized labels and disabled, aria-disabled and inert handling.
Keep actual submission and generated-media verification; clicking Send is not task completion, and uploaded references are not generated results.
Verify repository and bilingual dashboard community-promotion cleanup. Thanks to @WXJJ0520 for PR #48.
Hard-refresh after updating. Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; current versions need no reinstall. Older extensions require a manual update in every browser profile.
